end.summary:
- Practised top, front and side views of boxes, cones, cylinders, cubes and cups.
- Matched 4 of 4 views to the correct object without help.
- Described a box top as a square and its side as a rectangle.
- Mixed up the front and side views of a box and explained them as the same.
- Revised the cup-handle view after considering the other person’s position; the hidden-feature drawing mix-up remained.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised identifying what solids look like from different places and matched all four view-to-object examples using the visible shape and position. They first said another person would see the same cup handle, then corrected this by noticing that the handle faced away from the other person. At home, place a cup or box in different positions and ask Reyansh to draw only the parts visible from each viewpoint.
